atoms.meaning: Positive energy-momentum support E>=|P| gives forward tube; Lorentz SO(3,1) covariance and spacelike locality yield extended/permuted extended tube and Euclidean continuation, in the conventional cited framework.

Printed H=omega psi(t) psi_dagger(t) in that order, omega>0, (i d/dt-omega)psi=0, psi=a exp(-i omega t), psi_dagger=a_dagger exp(i omega t), [a,a_dagger]=1; nonrelativistic single momentum mode conditional omega=|p|²/(2m).

W2(t1,t2)=exp(-i omega(t1-t2)), Fourier distribution delta(E-omega), holomorphic W2(z)=exp(-i omega z), S2(tau)=exp(-omega tau), Schwartz test-function smeared fields and source-normalized state inner product 4 pi² conjugate(fhat(omega))*ghat(omega).

Original Minkowski/Wightman H1=Schwartz(R)/{f:W2(f,f)=0} has one complex dimension, full H=S*(H1). This is a distinct reconstruction from the later Osterwalder-Schrader positive-imaginary-time quotient.
